title: BanG Dream!
synopsis:
Kasumi Toyama was enthralled by the stars as a young girl, so when she discovers a trail of star-shaped signs one day after transferring to a new school, she can't help but follow them. They lead her to a shop run by the grandmother of one of her new classmates, and Kasumi finds something that will change her life forever: a star-shaped guitar! And just like that, Kasumi knows that forming a band is her destiny.

Of course, convincing Arisa and her grandmother to sell her the guitar won't be easy, and finding a group of other girls who want to become musicians will be even harder. But when a girl has stars in her eyes and a starbeat in her heart, there's nothing that will stop Kasumi from making her fantasies come true!

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

episodes.title: We Met!
episodes.synopsis: One day, as she’s still adjusting to her new high school, Kasumi Toyama discovers a trail of stars that leads her to an old thrift store. Inside, she makes a discovery.

episodes.title: We Did It!
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi's heart is set on forming a band, but Arisa wants nothing do with it. In fact, Arisa is so determined to avoid her that she puts the star-shaped guitar up for auction.

episodes.title: I Ran Away!
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi asks Rimi to join her band, but Rimi is reluctant. Meanwhile, Glitter*Green runs into an issue on the way to their show.

episodes.title: I Got Angry!
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi starts staying after school to take guitar lessons from Tae. Meanwhile, Arisa seems to have a problem with all the time they are spending together.

episodes.title: My Heart Was Racing!
episodes.synopsis: asumi, Tae, and friends are preparing for their first performance. Are they going to be ready in time?

episodes.title: I Made It!
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi begins to struggle in school and enlists Saya's help. Meanwhile, Arisa has been searching for the perfect band name.

episodes.title: We Fought!
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi has a tall order in convincing Saya to join Poppin Party, is she able to do it? Meanwhile, they continue to get ready for the Culture Festival!

episodes.title: I Ran!
episodes.synopsis: The Cultural Festival preparations are done, and it is time for it to begin. Meanwhile, Poppin' Party play their first show! How does it go?

episodes.title: I Got a Job!
episodes.synopsis: Saya gets a new drum set and the girls all get jobs at Space! They learn what goes into putting on a live show.

episodes.title: I Was Surprised!
episodes.synopsis: Poppin' Party auditions at Space but to play there you must impress the owner. Do they achieve their dream?

episodes.title: I Couldn't Sing Anymore
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi is still struggling to find her voice but the rest of Poppin' Party is there to help pick her up.

episodes.title: I Sparkled?!
episodes.synopsis: Poppin' Party gets another chance to play at Space. Will they finally impress the owner?

episodes.title: We Sang!
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi finally achieves her dream as Poppin' Party plays at Space's last show. How will they perform?
